g.text: XEMACS | 5V logic, regulated 2.5V sensor / resistor ladder.

g.desc: XEMACS | 5V logic, regulated 2.5V sensor / resistor ladder.

g.text: Comparator pull-ups: R17-R24 = 2.2k. All support resistors and capacitors use hand-solderable 0805 footprints.

g.desc: Comparator pull-ups: R17-R24 = 2.2k. All support resistors and capacitors use hand-solderable 0805 footprints.

g.text: MCP1700: pin 1 GND, pin 2 VIN, pin 3 VOUT. C5/C6: 2.2uF X7R,16V; effective capacitance >=1uF.

g.desc: MCP1700: pin 1 GND, pin 2 VIN, pin 3 VOUT. C5/C6: 2.2uF X7R,16V; effective capacitance >=1uF.

g.text: Core ADC / display / ladder / controls remain through-hole. U7 and level LEDs are surface mount.

g.desc: Core ADC / display / ladder / controls remain through-hole. U7 and level LEDs are surface mount.

g.text: Unfabricated design draft. LED levels indicate voltage thresholds; ambient lux is not calibrated.

g.desc: Unfabricated design draft. LED levels indicate voltage thresholds; ambient lux is not calibrated.

g.text: U7 isolates the LM339 outputs from LED current.

g.desc: U7 isolates the LM339 outputs from LED current.

g.text: HIGH = threshold crossed; LEDs accumulate from D1 to D7.

g.desc: HIGH = threshold crossed; LEDs accumulate from D1 to D7.

g.text: Both output enables are LOW. Unused input is grounded.

g.desc: Both output enables are LOW. Unused input is grounded.

g.text: C7: place beside U7 pins 20 and 10.

g.desc: C7: place beside U7 pins 20 and 10.

g.text: 1.5k limits each red LED to approximately 2mA.

g.desc: 1.5k limits each red LED to approximately 2mA.

g.text: LEVEL_1 ... LEVEL_7 also feed encoder inputs I7 ... I1.
